classification_rationale: The positive APP12509 capture used by D263 is the recovered D230 corpus capture. Its UI, acquisition command, operator markers and OEM workflow were not preserved; no historical workflow label can be assigned without invention.

sources.observation: The recovered corpus identifies rilevamento.pcapng and its SHA-256, but contains no UI or acquisition-workflow provenance.
D263 uses the recovered positive capture for the post-arm sequence and separately excludes the zero-finger D255 capture from that positive subtree.
D255 explicitly records WINDOWS_HELLO_SETUP_NO_FINGER, but it is a distinct zero-finger capture and cannot identify the D263 positive workflow.
The canonical D255 section states that the exact UI of the surviving positive historical capture was not preserved.

selection_rationale: Windows Hello setup is the only locally demonstrated post-attach OEM UI path, but only in the zero-finger D255 run. It is therefore a future candidate, not proof of the D263 workflow.
